item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Terminals now have a scrollbar. It follows your Ghostty scrollbar setting, matches a light or dark terminal background, and appears when you hover over the right edge if your Mac is set to always show scroll bars.
  • Terminal ▸ Scroll to Top (⌘↑) and Scroll to Bottom (⌘↓) jump to either end of the scrollback.
  • When you've scrolled up, a ↓ button appears at the bottom-right of the terminal; click it to jump back to the latest output.
  • After you send a snippet from the sidebar, its context menu or the snippet editor, the keyboard goes back to the terminal, so you can keep typing without clicking first.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0

item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Reconnecting no longer clears the terminal. A new session continues on the screen the last one left, so the output you were reading survives the reconnect.
  • A dropped session now retries on its own with backoff, which makes a remote reboot something a tab recovers from rather than something you restart.
  • Press Space or Return on a disconnected tab to reconnect, and the tab now says so. ⌘R still works; before, it was the only way back and nothing on screen mentioned it.
  • Connecting to a host that is still booting now gives up in seconds instead of burning about 75 seconds of silent retries, and a peer that vanishes without closing the connection is noticed instead of leaving the tab hanging on a dead socket.
  • SFTP tabs report their real state. A usable lftp tab no longer sits on "Connecting…", a live session no longer offers to reconnect, and a dropped lftp connection dims the tab indicator instead of tearing down a prompt still holding your working directory, bookmarks, and queued transfers.
  • lftp now uses interactive timeouts in place of its shipped defaults, which are built for unattended mirroring. A dead host reports in about 14 seconds and names itself, rather than hanging silently for over a minute.
  • ⌘S now toggles the hosts sidebar and ⌘B toggles the snippets sidebar — ⌘B was the hosts sidebar before. In the snippet editor, Save moves to ⌘Return.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.5.1...v0.6.0

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Fixed the terminal staying light while macOS is in Dark mode. The light/dark theme pair resolved once at startup and then stopped following the system, so whichever appearance you launched in was the one you kept. Switching appearance now works in both directions, every time.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.1

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • The terminal now follows your macOS appearance. Switching to Light mode gives you a light terminal instead of staying dark. If you set a single theme in your own Ghostty config it still wins — use theme = light:Some Light,dark:Some Dark to follow the system there too.
  • Scrollback now holds 100,000 lines. The previous limit was measured in bytes, not lines, which made the buffer far smaller than intended and discarded long output early.
  • Lower memory use on long-lived sessions. The terminal engine now compresses idle scrollback, cutting its memory footprint substantially — which matters when you keep many tabs open.
  • Faster tab opening, plus fixes for display and font edge cases that could disrupt a session.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.4.5...v0.5.0

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description:
What's Changed

Improvements

  • Sidebar search and "add" controls now mirror the layout used in the Snippets sidebar
  • Sidebar focus, resize behavior, and toolbar layout are now smoother and more consistent
  • Keyboard navigation from search fields now launches connections directly

Fixes

  • Fixed an infinite notification loop triggered by sidebar search focus
  • Untitled windows (menus, popovers) no longer incorrectly get centered on screen
  • Renamed "New Group Folder" to "New Connection Group" for clarity

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
What's Changed

New

  • Snippets panel in the right sidebar, with a dedicated editor window and View/Find menu commands
  • Snippets and snippet groups are saved to settings and survive export/import
  • Connection icon now appears in the tab bar, left of the tab title

Fixes

  • Sidebar edge no longer oscillates when hovering near the resize zone

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
What's Changed

New

  • Add ⌘T to duplicate a tab and ⌘W to close it
  • Add ⌘1–⌘9 shortcuts to switch directly to a tab by position
  • Add a Test Connection button in the connection editor
  • Sidebar auto-hides when connected; reveal it by hovering the left edge or pressing ⌘B
  • Double-clicking a connection in the sidebar always opens a new connection instance

Improvements

  • Switched to native TabView for sidebar navigation; requires macOS 15 or later
  • Connection editor window is now resizable, with a Settings sidebar and ⌘L to focus the toolbar

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • SSH Config host tabs now render correctly as single-line entries, matching all other tab types
  • Group rows in the sidebar now support Finder-style single-click to select and double-click to rename
  • Login-script step values can be locked and stored securely in the macOS Keychain
  • Automatic updates via Sparkle 2, served from a GitHub Pages appcast

Full Changelog: https://github.com/babul/quay/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
